classes.name: Speeder Bike

ability-pack.name: Ability Pack
ability-pack.short: A pack of 3 random Abilities. Select 1 to install.

ability.name: Ability
ability.short: Equippable tech that provides offensive, defensive, or utility capabilites. Consume Energy to activate.

afterburner-2.name: Afterburner
afterburner-2.short: A safe and efficient boost. The tank gradually refills while racing.

afterburner.name: Afterburner
afterburner.short: How quickly the vehicle accelerates, decelerates, and how much boost is received from Afterburner.

air-brake.name: Air Brake
air-brake.short: How tightly the vehicle can turn while Air Braking.

autopilot.name: Autopilot
autopilot.short: Vehicle flies automatically for 10s. Ramjet heating reduced while active.

battery.name: Battery
battery.short: The maximum amount of Energy available to activate Abilities.

burning.name: Burning
burning.short: Causes Ramjet to rapidly gain heat.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.short: Become Cooled, but gradually causes Frozen.

concussion-mine.name: Concussion Mine
concussion-mine.short: Drop a charge that explodes on proximity and applies Concussed and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

cooled.name: Cooled
cooled.short: Ramjet recharges more quickly and gains heat more slowly.

cornering.name: Cornering
cornering.short: How quickly and tightly the vehicle can take corners.

corroded.name: Corroded
corroded.short: Chokes Ramjet, causing it to disable. Continued exposure quickly leads to Crash.

crash-ability.name: Crash Ability
crash-ability.short: Activated during a Crash. Does not cost Energy.

crash.name: Crash
crash.short: Catastrophic vehicle failure due to collision, impact, or explosion. Limited Crashes allowed per event.

critical-malfunction.name: Critical Malfunction
critical-malfunction.short: Causes high susceptibility to collision damage. Afterburner, Ramjet, and Abilities are disabled.

disrupted.name: Disrupted
disrupted.short: Blocks Abilities and Overcharged while applying Choked, System Malfunction, and reducing speed.

drift.name: Drift
drift.short: How sharply the landspeeder turns and how much speed is maintained while using Drift.

energy.name: Energy
energy.short: Spent to activate Abilities. Increased by Battery.

fault.name: Fault
fault.short: A malfunctioning Part that cannot be replaced until repaired. Faults can be repaired at the Scrap Dealer.

flame-vent.name: Flame Vent
flame-vent.short: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat. Applies Burning and System Malfunction to nearby opponents.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.short: Significantly impairs steering, as well as cools Ramjet.

ion-bolt.name: Ion Bolt
ion-bolt.short: Lock on to the closest nearby opponent and apply Disrupted to target.

kinetic-burst.name: Kinetic Burst
kinetic-burst.short: How powerful the speeder bike's Kinetic Burst braking is and how much speed is restored upon release.

knife-edge.name: Knife Edge
knife-edge.short: How tightly the skim speeder turns and how much speed is maintained while using Knife Edge.

maneuvering.name: Maneuvering
maneuvering.short: Use Improved Steering to Drift, Kinetic Burst, or Knife Edge.

overcharged.name: Overcharged
overcharged.short: Gain temporary Energy and reduce Ability reload times.

overtaking-surge.name: Overtaking Surge
overtaking-surge.short: Gain Surging for 10s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration and increase its potency.

part-pack.name: Part Pack
part-pack.short: A pack of 3 random Parts. Select 1 to install.

part.name: Part
part.short: Installed to a vehicle to provide passive effects. The higher the rarity, the stronger the effect.

perfect-landing.name: Perfect Landing
perfect-landing.short: Landing a jump with vehicle pitch parallel to the ground results in a temporary boost.

perfect-start.name: Perfect Start
perfect-start.short: Temporary boost gained from Perfect acceleration check upon race start.

pre-race-checks.name: Pre-Race Checks
pre-race-checks.short: Checks at race start which, when completed successfully, give additional benefits.

ramjet-2.name: Ramjet
ramjet-2.short: How much boost is provided by the Ramjet.

ramjet.name: Ramjet
ramjet.short: A powerful but dangerous boost. Managing the heat it generates will prevent exploding.

redlining.name: Redlining
redlining.short: Racing within the red zone prior to the Ramjet overheating and exploding, indicated by an alarm.

resilience.name: Resilience
resilience.short: How well the vehicle can handle damage, avoid Malfunctions, and resist negative status effects.

shielded.name: Shielded
shielded.short: Increases protection from collisions and impacts as well as blocks externally-applied status effects.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.short: Blast nearby opponents away and apply System Malfunction to affected opponents.

slipstreaming.name: Slipstreaming
slipstreaming.short: A speed bonus gained while flying closely behind an opponent.

speed.name: Speed
speed.short: The unboosted top speed of your vehicle.

status-scrubber.name: Status Scrubber
status-scrubber.short: Clear negative status effects. If any are cleared, recover 1 Energy.

supercooled-vent.name: Supercooled Vent
supercooled-vent.short: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat while gradually gaining Frozen. Upon fully Frozen, Vent disengages.

surge.name: Surge
surge.short: Gain Surging for 10s, lost on impact. Overtakes extend the duration.

system-malfunction.name: System Malfunction
system-malfunction.short: Causes high susceptibility to collision damage.

takedown.name: Takedown
takedown.short: Any action directly causing an opponent to Crash. Fully refills Afterburner tank.

upgrade-pack.name: Upgrade Pack
upgrade-pack.short: A pack of 3 random +1 Upgrades. Select 1 to install.

upgrade.name: Upgrade
upgrade.short: Upgrades the vehicle’s top speed and one of its stats: Afterburner, Battery, Cornering, Maneuvering, Ramjet, or Resilience.

vectored-shockwave.name: Vectored Shockwave
vectored-shockwave.short: Blast nearby opponents away, propelling you forward and applying System Malfunction to affected opponents.

vent.name: Vent
vent.short: Gain Cooled and reduce Ramjet heat.
